title: Pierce-Birkhoff conjecture is false
summary: We provide a counterexample to the Pierce-Birkhoff conjecture: a continuous function that is piecewise quadratic on a finite collection of semialgebraic sets that partition $\mathbb{R}^n$ but that cannot be expressed as a finite lattice combination of polynomials. The counterexample was found with the assistance of our multi-agent, multi-model setup that chains together GPT 5.6, GPT 6, Claude Opus 5, and Claude Fable 5.1.
